notes: The page does not say when applications open next year.
name: Loudoun Youth Advisory Council (YAC)
org: Loudoun County Parks, Recreation and Community Services (PRCS)
what_you_do: Student-led group that plans special events, runs marketing and media, and works on youth awareness projects. PRCS teen services staff mentor the teens.
who_can_apply: Teens who live in Loudoun County. The page lists recruiting high schools but gives no age or grade range.
deadline_text: Applications are closed for the 2026-2027 school year. Next opening not posted.
how_to_apply: Applications are closed. Ask through the contact form on the page or call 703-777-0343.
